regulation: MPERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Tariff for Supply and Wheeling of Electricity and Methods and Principles for Fixation of Charges) Regulations, 2021
note: MPERC's interest on working capital for a distribution licensee, wheeling and supply apart, as the FY2026-27 order for the three MP DISCOMs quotes and applies it — the engine's third commission.  The years the 2021 Regulations govern are not established here, so the rules carry no year bounds yet.

rules.title: Wheeling: O&M expenses for one month

clause.regulation: MPERC (Terms and Conditions for Determination of Tariff for Supply and Wheeling of Electricity and Methods and Principles for Fixation of Charges) Regulations, 2021
clause.excerpt: 23. Working capital.- 23.1. Working capital for supply activity of the Licensee shall consist of: (i)Receivables of two months of average billing reduced by power purchase cost of one month, consumer security deposit, and any amount paid by the prepaid consumers, (ii)O&M expenses for one month, and (iii)Inventory (meters, metering equipment, testing equipment are particularly relevant in case of supply activity) for 2 months based on annual requirement considered at 1% of the Gross Fixed Assets for previous year. 23.2. Working capital for wheeling activity of the Licensee shall consist of: (i)O and M expenses for one month, and (ii)Inventory (excluding meters, etc., which are considered part of supply activity) for 2 months based on annual requirement considered at 1% of the gross fixed assets for previous year. … 38. Interest charges on working capital.- Working capital shall be computed as provided in these Regulations and Rate of interest on working capital shall be equal to the Base Rate as on 1st April of the relevant Year plus 350 basis points. …

rules.note: the excerpt is the order's own quotation of Regs. 23 and 38 (MP DISCOMs FY2026-27 order, pp.105–106), not read from the Regulations; the order puts the whole month of O&M in the wheeling activity, none in supply (Reg. 23.1(ii) names it for both)
